intro.h2: Bathroom Remodeling in Sacramento That Holds Up to Six Kids
paragraphs: Andrey Tsushko started Thrive, a family-owned firm focused on bathroom remodeling in Sacramento, after years of replacing cheap fixtures in his own house. He and his wife are raising six homeschooled kids, so their bathrooms get slammed doors, endless showers and the odd experiment. That is the test he builds to: easy-to-clean surfaces, sturdy hardware and materials that last.

The other half of the pitch is accountability. Every job runs behind sealed work zones with dust control and daily cleanup, carries a 3-year no-questions-asked warranty on installation workmanship, and comes with an On-Time Promise. If the crew is late, you get $100 back for each delayed day.

services.h2: Showers, Tubs, Vanities and Full Bath Remodels

items.name: Complete Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: From a new layout down to the final finishes. Thrive handles planning, demolition, installation and final inspection, so you are not managing separate trades. Primary baths can include freestanding soaking tubs, dual vanities and custom tile showers for a calmer, spa-like room.

image.alt: Remodeled primary bathroom with freestanding white tub, wood-look tile floor, white vanities and a large window

items.name: Tub-to-Shower Conversions
items.blurb: Swap an old tub for a walk-in shower that is easier to step into and easier to clean. Options include slip-resistant shower floors, built-in niches, frameless glass doors and waterproof wall panels. A Citrus Heights conversion added bench seating and a handheld shower.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with frameless glass door, white marble-look walls and a dark pebble shower floor

items.name: Small Bathroom and Vanity Upgrades
items.blurb: Tight hall baths get smarter layouts, floating vanities, backlit mirrors and better lighting. Thrive uses nonporous, mold-resistant surfaces that stand up to Sacramento's hard water, so the room stays looking new with less scrubbing and fits a busy morning routine.

image.alt: Small bathroom with floating black vanity, under-cabinet lighting, round backlit mirror and glass globe pendants

items.name: Bathtub Replacement
items.blurb: An outdated, damaged or hard-to-clean tub can be replaced without a full gut. Most shower and bathtub replacements can be finished in just a few days, so your household is not stuck without a working bathroom for weeks.

image.alt: Hall bathroom with new alcove tub, sliding glass doors, marble-look surround with niche and dark tile floor

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: The same guarantees now cover kitchens: custom cabinetry, quartz or granite counters, islands, backsplash tile and full layout changes. One point of contact and one schedule cover cabinets, counters, tile and electrical from demo day to the final walkthrough.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with white shaker cabinets, wood island with open shelving, quartz counters and gray tile floor

items.title: 3-year workmanship warranty
items.text: Installation workmanship is covered for three years, no questions asked. If something is not right, Thrive says it will make it right, fast and hassle-free.

items.title: On-Time Promise
items.text: Thrive puts real money behind its schedule. If they are late on your project, you get $100 back for each delayed day.

items.title: Sealed, dust-controlled work zones
items.text: Your home is protected with sealed work zones, dust control and cleanup after every workday. Esther A. noted the crew cleaned up at the end of each day.

items.title: Straight pricing up front
items.text: Every project starts with a free in-home consultation and a clear, upfront quote before any work begins, so there are no surprises once the project starts.

about.h2: Meet Andrey Tsushko, Founder and Dad of Six
about.text: Andrey Tsushko founded Thrive Home Construction as a family-owned bathroom remodeling company. He and his wife are parents of six homeschooled kids, and their own bathrooms take constant heavy use. After replacing cheap materials too many times, Andrey built the business around bathrooms that last: durable, easy-to-clean surfaces and sturdy hardware, paired with modern designs from the professional designers Thrive partners with. His team of builders, installers and designers keeps you updated throughout, and his stated rule is simple: a bathroom is not done until you are fully satisfied.

image.alt: Andrey Tsushko, founder of Thrive Home Construction in Sacramento

service_area.h2: East and Northeast Sacramento Region Service Area
service_area.text: Thrive works from its office at 1750 Howe Ave in Sacramento and covers the east and northeast Sacramento region. Portfolio projects include a walk-in shower in Roseville, a full bath in Rocklin, a spa-style primary bath in Folsom and an accessible tub-to-shower conversion in Citrus Heights. The team also lists Carmichael, Fair Oaks, Granite Bay, El Dorado Hills, Lincoln, Davis, Woodland and more.

items.q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
items.a: Most full bathroom projects finish in 5 to 8 weeks, depending on scope, and smaller conversions can be faster. Most shower and bathtub replacements are done in just a few days. With the On-Time Promise, you get $100 back for each day the project runs late.

Thrive offers a 3-year warranty on its installation workmanship with no questions asked. If something is not right with the installation after your remodel, the team will make it right, fast, fair and hassle-free. That promise covers both bathroom and kitchen projects, giving you peace of mind long after the final walkthrough.

Yes. Thrive handles the required permits and follows local building codes on your behalf. On its Carmichael page, the company notes it manages all Sacramento County permits so homeowners do not have to deal with that paperwork themselves. Ask during your consultation which permits your project needs.

items.q: Will the materials hold up to Sacramento's hard water?
items.a: Thrive uses durable, nonporous surfaces that resist mold, mildew and the hard water buildup common in the Sacramento area. That means less scrubbing and a shower or vanity that keeps looking new, which matters in a busy family bathroom used many times a day.

Yes. Thrive offers a free in-home consultation with no obligation. The team looks at your space, talks through how you use it and what bothers you, and gives you straightforward pricing before any work begins. Call (916) 308-4575 or send the quote form to book.
